Screen Translate can use Android\'s Accessibility Service to notice when you scroll or switch to another app, so it can re-translate automatically when the screen changes and hide or update the translation overlay when you change apps.

The Accessibility Service only uses the name of the app in front; it does not read on-screen text or perform taps or gestures, and does not collect or transmit your personal data. It runs only after you turn it on yourself.\n\nOptional: without it you can still translate manually; turn it off anytime in Settings > Accessibility.

To turn it on:
1. Tap “Agree”
2. Find “Screen Translate Scroll Detection” in Accessibility settings
3. Turn the service on
